2027 EnrolmentAdvantage

9–30 Nov 2026 · Internal promotion guide

Select a product to review its promotion, package fees and savings against standard prices.

9–30 November 2026

Product A · Academic Coaching

Total savings comprise three components. Add them together to calculate the saving for each sign-up.

01 · Package discountStandard savings

Standard lesson fees minus the regular package fee.

+
02 · Promotion discountS$60.00 × packages

Lite: no additional course-fee discount. One package: S$60.00. Three packages: S$180.00.

+
03 · Registration discountS$40.00 per sign-up

One discount per sign-up, including three packages. Pay S$40.00 instead of S$80.00 where applicable.
